messages.author: e4809221db8cd0ae
messages.subject: Error
parts:
Hello all!! 
I am new to methylKit and I keep coming up with the error: Error in .local(location, sample.id, assembly, dbtype, pipeline, header,  :
  Cannot directly load uncompressed file:
 coverage2cytosine_output.CpG_report.txt

Please provide sample.id and assembly

However, I have the sample.id and assembly listed in my code. The file I am loading in is from Bismark's coverage2cytosine. Is there a problem with this? I set my working directory before this on R Studio. 
 Here is my code:

file.list3=list("coverage2cytosine_output.CpG_report.txt")

myobj=methRead(file.list3[[1]],
               sample.id=list("coverage2cytosine_output.CpG_report"),
               assembly="hg18",
               dbtype= tabix,
               pipeline="bismarkCytosineReport",
               header=FALSE,
               context="CpG",
               treatment=c(1),
               mincov = 10
)
